A bright quiet contemporary café workspace, pale oak table, softly blurred window, green plants and warm daylight; clean foreground with plenty of empty space. Medium waist-up closing product-review portrait, SAME presenter smiling naturally and holding the exact lavender power bank steadily at chest height in BOTH hands, front three-quarter orientation identical to the reference, complete loop strap visible. Product dominates center without being oversized. Table clear in foreground. Frame leaves clear room at lower edge for a purchase CTA added later.
